messages:
mara: Quick sync — we need a final pass on the landing copy for the tri-mode page. Goal: single hero that communicates predictability + choice, then three tailored CTAs. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jake: Agree. Want the hero to speak to the core thesis: performance + predictable cost across environments. Short headline + 1-line subhead that covers Hosted / Dedicated / Private as mode examples, not full explanations.

leo: I mocked two hero options in Figma, will drop after this thread. Option A: punchy, product-first. Option B: softer, benefit-first. Both keep the three cards below.

ana: For conversion, CTA verbs need to map to funnel: Hosted -> 'Start free', Dedicated -> 'Talk to sales', Private -> 'Request trial / On-prem demo'. We should route submissions differently.

sam: Draft headline proposal: "Predictable LLM inference at production scale" Subhead: "Fast hosted APIs, reserved capacity, or private deployments — same developer experience, tuned for latency and cost."

mara: Good. Can we tighten subhead to 1 shorter sentence? Maybe: "Fast hosted APIs, reserved capacity, or private deployments — same API, predictable performance."

jake: Love it. Then we need microcopy for the three hero CTAs (small descriptor under each CTA) + form routing rules. Proposed microcopy: Hosted: "Start with our hosted API — instant onboarding and usage-based pricing." Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools with SLA-backed throughput." Private: "VPC or on-prem deployments for regulated workloads."

leo: Visual note — make the Hosted CTA the primary button style, Dedicated secondary, Private tertiary. That matches expected traffic.

ana: Routing logic idea: include a hidden field in the lead form named deployment_interest with values [hosted, dedicated, private]. Then an SDR workflow splits: hosted -> nurture play + product trial, dedicated -> AE outreach within 24h, private -> security/solutions engineer + AE. Also tag lead with "bench_trial" if they click "Start free" after viewing benchmarks.

sam: Example form snippet for engineers/devx team to implement: ```html
<input type="hidden" name="deployment_interest" id="deployment_interest">
<script>
// set value on CTA click
document.querySelector('#cta-hosted').addEventListener('click', ()=> document.getElementById('deployment_interest').value='hosted')
</script>
```

mara: Nice — add GA events: event_category="tri_mode_leads" event_action="cta_click" event_label="hosted/dedicated/private". Ana, can you map to HubSpot fields?

ana: Yup. HubSpot fields: lead_source=website, lifecycle_stage=lead, deployment_interest=XXX, score+=10 if bench_view. I can set automation to route based on deployment_interest.

jake: Copy tweak for benchmark callout: "Benchmarks: sub-ms tail latency on common prompt shapes, throughput tuning for burst workloads." Keep it non-technical but credible — link to deeper benchmarks page.

sam: Suggested hero CTA texts: Hosted -> "Start free account" Dedicated -> "Get dedicated capacity" Private -> "Request private deployment" Small descriptors under buttons as earlier.

leo: UX: add a small "Compare modes" link under hero that scrolls to a 3-column comparison. Also add an anchor for the benchmarks section.

mara: Timeline: copy freeze EOD Thursday; design freeze Friday; dev ready early next week. Can everyone confirm? :calendar:

jake: Confirmed from PM side. I'll own QA on microcopy in the comparison table.

leo: Confirmed — I'll hand off Figma assets by Thursday noon.

ana: I'll wire HubSpot flows and test routing on staging Thursday evening.

sam: I'll update web copy, meta tags, and CTA aria-labels. Will post a diff in the docs channel when ready.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview created: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/tri-mode-landing/1767778888 (expires in 72h) :rocket:

mara: Perfect. Last ask — voice: keep it pragmatic and engineering-friendly, but avoid jargon like "KV cache" in hero. Save those for the benchmarks and docs.

jake: Noted. I'll add a short explainer line for developers under the comparison: "Same API. Different economics and controls."

sam: Final microcopy checklist I'll paste after this thread. Will need someone to sanity check the routing snippet once it's live.

mara: Thanks team — big step toward launch. I'll consolidate the final copy in the page doc and ping again for signoff. :sparkles:
